articles.title: Trump’s Putin Outreach Tests Ukraine Talks
articles.summary: Bloomberg White House and National Security Editor Michelle Jamrisko tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump’s summit with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping reinforced his approach to diplomacy but left major questions unresolved over Ukraine and potential US security guarantees. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Jamrisko discusses European skepticism toward Putin, tensions within the Trump administration and Vice President JD Vance’s effort to distinguish his views as he looks toward 2028. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Putin Gains From Trump, Xi Summit Spotlight
articles.summary: Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Jeff Mason tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Vladimir Putin emerged as a key beneficiary of his historic meeting with President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, returning to the global stage alongside the US and Chinese leaders despite Russia’s continuing war in Ukraine. articles.title: Trump’s Putin Ties Draw Focus After Summit
articles.summary: Bloomberg Economics Analyst Alex Kokcharov tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump’s historic meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping produced limited concrete results despite a joint declaration on energy, nuclear risks and other global issues. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kokcharov explains what Trump’s relationship with Putin means for Ukraine as Europe takes on more of Kyiv’s support and the war intensifies after Ukraine’s latest attack on the Crimean Bridge. (Source: Bloomberg)
